title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Genesis 18: the three visitors at Mamre, Sarah's laughter and Abraham pleading for Sodom.

questions.text: Where did Yahweh appear to Abraham as he sat in the tent door?
questions.explanation: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

questions.text: How many men did Abraham see standing near him?
questions.explanation: Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw that three men stood near him, and he ran to meet them.

questions.text: What did Abraham fetch from the herd for his guests?
questions.explanation: Abraham ran to the herd and fetched a tender and good calf, and he set it before them with butter and milk.

answers.text: A fat ram from the flock

questions.text: Where was Sarah when she heard the promise that she would have a son?
questions.explanation: Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

answers.text: In the tent door, behind him
Out in the field with the flocks
Under the tree with the guests

questions.text: What question did Yahweh ask after Sarah laughed?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asked why Sarah laughed, and said, "Is anything too hard for Yahweh?"

answers.text: "Why are you afraid to speak to me?"

questions.text: Why did Sarah deny that she had laughed?
questions.explanation: Sarah denied it, saying, "I didn't laugh," for she was afraid. He said, "No, but you did laugh."

answers.text: She had not heard the promise
She thought it was a joke

questions.text: The cry of which two cities did Yahweh say was great?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous, I will go down now."

questions.text: What was the first number of righteous people Abraham asked about?
questions.explanation: Abraham asked, "What if there are fifty righteous within the city?" and Yahweh said He would spare the place for their sake.

questions.text: How did Abraham describe himself while speaking to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Abraham said, "See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes."

answers.text: As a worm in the ground
As a stranger in the land

questions.text: For the sake of how many righteous did Yahweh finally say He would not destroy the city?
questions.explanation: Abraham asked one last time, "What if ten are found there?" Yahweh said, "I will not destroy it for the ten's sake."
